listing.name: DriveClub (DriveClub Recomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for DriveClub Recomp; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Online features do not work. EU build less played; other patches/repacked dumps untested. Upstream gameplay claims remain separate from qualification. Windows x64 Vulkan1.3 CPU Haswell/Excavator onward; European edition less tested; online unavailable and different versions untested. Avoid name recomp implying PowerPC translation. Upstream platforms: Windows 10/11 x64, Haswell/Excavator/Ryzen CPU, Vulkan 1.3. US/EU v1.28; other OS routes not established. Original data: PS4 DriveClub CUSA00093 or CUSA00003 v1.28 own dump. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
